format: yerk recall-bench question set (example, invented). One entry per question: q is asked of recall; a hit counts when every answer_tokens string appears in a result's text inside the top k and the path is not a stale copy (the `stale` pattern). A control question must hit, or the run reports the instrument blind. kind is free text; the weekly set keeps fact, event, decision, person, preference, correction, feeling and the two room kinds of decision 20: room-recent (what was sent in a room recently) and room-day (what was said in a room on a day).

questions.q: which units does the owner prefer
when does the weekly review happen
how often does the plant need water
what has to be renewed before the 20th
what did the owner finish and want more of
what went on the shopping list
was the review moved this week
what was sent in example-room recently
what did you say in example-room on 2026-01-07
